about: Pilots and artifacts: the ONE spec. Tools/Build/author_pilot_assets.py writes the Unity assets from it (--check is the drift gate). Design: Docs/Pilots/PILOTS_AND_ARTIFACTS.md (2026-10-26 draft) building on Docs/PILOTS_AND_ARTIFACTS.md (2026-10-12). id and statId values are saved by players or serialized: never rename an id, never renumber or reuse a statId. Text is printable ASCII (the UI font has no other glyphs). A rank label's 'kind' defaults to what the label reads as (+N Add, +N% Percent, xN Multiply); 'Set' is given where the value replaces the base.

pilots.name: Shrapnel
pilots.rule: Skyburst blasts throw a ring of small prisms in your domain outward, so every missile breaks rival mass and builds yours.
pilots.ai: Fires into the densest rival mass.
pilots.source: Destruction effects also create mini-prisms in all directions.

pilots.name: Flux
pilots.rule: Pulsefire rounds are waves: a widening arc that shoves prisms aside instead of popping them. Clear a lane, or push rival mass into a pile.
pilots.ai: Opens a lane ahead when boxed in.
pilots.source: Projectiles become waves of energy that push blocks.

pilots.name: Reaper
pilots.rule: Rival prisms you skim rot: they wither into danger prisms over a few seconds, and the rot spreads once to the prisms they touch.
pilots.ai: Skims rival walls along their length.
pilots.source: Skimming corrupts enemy prisms.

pilots.name: Astrofoil
pilots.rule: While soaring, a blast that hits your prisms reflects: the wave runs back along the shot and breaks the attacker's prisms at the source.
pilots.ai: Soars when it is under fire.
pilots.source: Reflects destruction effects back at attackers. Aimed at their prisms, not their vessel.

pilots.name: Scales
pilots.rule: The Seed Wall grows as overlapping scales. A brick that is hit hands its shield to the brick behind it instead of falling, so the wall wears down from the front.
pilots.ai: Plants walls across lanes rivals use.
pilots.source: Was: all grown volume is shielded, which repeats the Mass level-5 shape.

pilots.name: Siphon
pilots.rule: Prisms your round destroys are stolen: they fly back and lock into your Seed Wall.
pilots.ai: Snipes rival mass close to its own wall.
pilots.source: Was: stolen volume grants temporary Mass (an element). Now the stolen volume builds the wall.

pilots.name: Tomahawk
pilots.rule: Throw the sword: double-tap the trigger and the energy blade spins out in an arc that follows your turn, cuts everything on its way, and comes back to the hull.
pilots.ai: Throws at walls it cannot reach.
pilots.source: Was: speed while turning. The arc follows your turn. A thrown blade that hits a rival scores through the Sword Steal hit.

pilots.name: Dozer
pilots.rule: The plough shovels instead of breaking: prisms pile up ahead of the nose and drop where you stop, as your own wall.
pilots.ai: Pushes rival mass into a pile in front of its lane.
pilots.source: Was: destruction ignores shields, which is the Rhino's Breaker level-5 upgrade.

pilots.name: Tenacious
pilots.rule: Your drift lays danger prisms instead of plain ones. The line you carve through a corner is a hazard for whoever follows.
pilots.ai: Drifts on the racing line when a rival is close behind.
pilots.source: Produce dangerous prisms instead of shielded ones. Tag: Shielded producer.

pilots.name: Trace
pilots.rule: Chase a rival's trail and you overwrite it: the trail you lay on top of theirs turns into your domain.
pilots.ai: Tails the leader.
pilots.source: Was: double charge from following. The chase is kept; the charge number is dropped.

pilots.name: Slingshot
pilots.rule: Pull both sticks together to wind up, throw them apart to fire: the release launches you at twice top speed for a few seconds.
pilots.ai: Winds up on straights before a crystal.
pilots.source: Slow (sticks together) to fast (sticks apart) boosts to x2 max speed. Tag: Double-Joystick.

pilots.name: Riptide
pilots.rule: Your prisms are mines: when a rival breaks one, it bursts and takes their nearby prisms with it.
pilots.ai: Lays trail where rivals fight.
pilots.source: Blocks that, when destroyed, explode and destroy opposing blocks.

pilots.name: Bushy
pilots.rule: The projected rail is three rails in a Y, the flux-capacitor shape: three lanes to ride, and the chain spikes cascade along all three.
pilots.ai: Projects the rail toward rival mass, then rides it.
pilots.source: Trail has a third segment, arranged like a flux capacitor. Tag: split trail. Moved from the Squirrel.

pilots.name: Heist
pilots.rule: Chain spikes steal: a cascade turns rival prisms into your domain instead of breaking them, so every chain grows the prismscape you ride.
pilots.ai: Fires into rival mass that joins its own.
pilots.source: Your destructive abilities steal. Tags: Destructive, Cultivator.

pilots.name: Maestro
pilots.rule: Play on the beat: a press in time with the music makes the keys you lay ring out a wave of extra volume.
pilots.ai: Presses on the beat; the AI reads the music clock.
pilots.source: Press on beat to produce extra rings of volume. Tag: Single-Joystick.
pilots.check: Notion tags Maestro Single-Joystick; the Butterfly is two-thumb, so the press would be a trigger tap. Moved from the Dolphin.

pilots.name: Damsel
pilots.rule: The dust settles: leave Dust mode and the dust capsule stays where it was, drifting down for 6 s and still working the mass below it.
pilots.ai: Leaves dust over its own mass before it switches mode.
pilots.source: Game asset only (old line: biggest blocks in open space). Moved from the Manta.

pilots.name: Krush
pilots.rule: Every rival prism the ball smashes kicks it faster, so a run of smashes keeps the ball red without spinning up again.
pilots.ai: Chains smashes along rival walls.
pilots.source: Destruction effects give you a speed boost. Moved from the Rhino.

pilots.name: Trapper
pilots.rule: Planting the ball lays a ring of tar prisms around the anchor: sticky prisms that slow whoever flies through them, you included.
pilots.ai: Plants across a chaser's line.
pilots.source: Was: prisms pull and slow opposing ships. Pulling a vessel breaks the PvP rule; a prism that slows anyone who touches it is an arena effect.

pilots.name: Mason
pilots.rule: Your switches are mortared. The bricks are bonded, a broken brick regrows from its neighbours after a few seconds, and a ball that hits the frame bounces off instead of breaking it.
pilots.ai: Places switches across the ball's lanes.
pilots.source: Was: skimming shields friendly prisms. Rebuilt around your Scarab example.

pilots.name: Echo
pilots.rule: Every ball you forge has an echo: a smaller twin, about 60% of its size, forged beside it, that follows the first ball's path a beat behind.
pilots.ai: Forges near switches.
pilots.source: For each volume produced, produce another slightly smaller (40-80%). Moved from the Dolphin.

pilots.name: Strider
pilots.rule: The paths you boost down stay behind as a lane: for 10 s anyone in your domain rides it at Pathfinder speed.
pilots.ai: Boosts down paths toward its team's objective.
pilots.source: The 20% / 50% numbers moved to the Tailwind artifact. Moved from the Squirrel.

pilots.name: Comet
pilots.rule: The orbit slingshot makes you a comet: for the length of the kick you pass through prisms and break them instead of hitting them.
pilots.ai: Slings through rival walls.
pilots.source: Crystal effects doubled moved to the Comet Shard artifact. Moved from the Serpent.

pilots.name: Tender
pilots.rule: Dens tend themselves: while the Pistol is within reach, a den regrows any prism taken from it.
pilots.ai: Keeps the Pistol near its best den.
pilots.source: Game asset only (old line: longest debuff from crystal decoy). Moved from the Manta.

pilots.name: Snap
pilots.rule: Hold to charge the Pistol's snap: the vortex ring grows while held, and on release carves a tunnel through prisms on its way to the locked rival.
pilots.ai: Charges a ring when the lock sits behind a wall.
pilots.source: New name (a pistol shrimp's snap).

pilots.name: Jugger
pilots.rule: Catch the thrown ring: fly through it before it fuses and it is back on the hull with the fuse reset, and your spare is kept.
pilots.ai: Throws, then catches when no target is in reach.
pilots.source: Game asset only (old line: biggest max shield size). Moved from the Rhino.

pilots.name: Nul
pilots.rule: In Speed mode the arena cannot touch you: danger and slow prisms in your path are cut by the ring before you feel them.
pilots.ai: Switches to Speed before crossing danger fields.
pilots.source: Was: ignore all negative effects. Narrowed to arena effects, because ignoring rival hits would break the petals-only rule.

pilots.name: Timebomb
pilots.rule: The Void Lance grows the longer it flies. A close shot pins one block; a long shot hollows out a whole wall.
pilots.ai: Takes the longest clear line it can find.
pilots.source: Projectiles grow larger the longer they are alive. Tag: Projectile user.

pilots.name: Ironclad
pilots.rule: Your nests are forts: while a nest's flora lives, the nest regrows its super-shielded blocks.
pilots.ai: Nests beside contested crystals.
pilots.source: Was: auto-shield your trail, which repeats several Mass level-5 upgrades.

pilots.name: Glimmer
pilots.rule: Paint sweeps: holding RT paints a wide fan instead of one point, so the half-school spreads across a whole wall instead of piling onto one prism.
pilots.ai: Sweeps long rival walls.
pilots.source: New name.

pilots.name: Pack
pilots.rule: A lock-on sends a pack of three that share the target and come back to the school after it falls, instead of one creature that is spent.
pilots.ai: Locks the rival with the most petals.
pilots.source: New name.
pilots.check: Changes what happens to creatures the school spends: check it against the locked ecosystem principles.

pilots.name: Feist
pilots.rule: Lighting the afterburner leaves a decoy: a ghost hull and kite fly on your old heading for 2 s, and AI pilots and homing missiles chase it.
pilots.ai: Burns when a rival sits on its tail.
pilots.source: Notion line was empty; the name now means a feint. Moved from the Sparrow (the Wrasse is its hull).

pilots.name: Lariat
pilots.rule: The tail lassos prisms too: close a loop around a cluster of rival prisms and the whole cluster is stolen.
pilots.ai: Loops clusters the pilot flies past.
pilots.source: New name.

pilots.name: Longshift
pilots.rule: Drop an outrigger: one gunner turret detaches and keeps firing at rival prisms for 8 s, and re-docks when the hull flies back through it.
pilots.ai: Drops a turret by a rival wall, then leaves.
pilots.source: Range and velocity moved to the Long Barrel artifact. Moved from the Sparrow.

pilots.name: Pod
pilots.rule: The gunners' missiles fly as a pod: if all three fire within a second they merge into one large missile that any gunner steers.
pilots.ai: AI gunners fire together when a human gunner fires.
pilots.source: New name (an orca pod).

pilots.name: Murmur
pilots.rule: Two murmurations: the swarm splits into two flocks that chase different objectives at once, and the next card you pick goes to the flock you are looking at.
pilots.ai: Looks at the flock nearer the objective.
pilots.source: New name.

pilots.name: Roost
pilots.rule: Between objectives the flock roosts on your mass: the prisms it lands on are shielded until it takes off again.
pilots.ai: Turns the view toward its own mass between phases.
pilots.source: New name.

pilots.name: Pincer
pilots.rule: Pull the thumbs apart while herding and the jacks fan out to the herd's flanks, driving it through a gap from both sides.
pilots.ai: Flanks herds aimed at a gap.
pilots.source: New name.

pilots.name: Shoal
pilots.rule: A herd you drive packs into a bait ball: a tight ball that rolls through rival prisms and breaks them.
pilots.ai: Drives the ball through rival walls.
pilots.source: New name.
pilots.check: Changes how real fauna moves: check it against the locked ecosystem principles.

pilots.name: Comb
pilots.rule: Patterns lock in: a pattern made three times is no longer replaced; it stays on the Dynamo and pays a slip charge every spin.
pilots.ai: The AI Ratel repeats its best pattern.
pilots.source: New name (a honeycomb).

pilots.name: Raid
pilots.rule: Zips steal: slip down a rival trail and it turns to your domain behind you as you pass.
pilots.ai: Slips along rival trails.
pilots.source: New name (the ratel raids the hive).

artifacts.name: Bomb Rack
artifacts.changes: Bombs the bay holds (3 at rest)
